ned05d97001d.s: In which year was India's TEPA with the EFTA countries concluded?
ned05d97001d.x: The India-EFTA TEPA dates from 2024, not 2022 as is often assumed.

n4e71a87e2a7.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the order of west-coast ports from north to south?
n4e71a87e2a7.x: From north to south the order is Deendayal, Mumbai, Mormugao, Kochi, so Kochi lies south of Mormugao.

nworld-geography-5-4.s: Which country is the largest producer of jute?
nworld-geography-5-4.x: India is the largest jute producer; Bangladesh is a major competitor, important in raw-jute exports.

nworld-geography-31-3.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Suez Route?
o: It is the shortest route between Europe and Asia
It connects Europe and Asia through the Suez Canal
It goes round the Cape of Good Hope
It avoids the voyage round Africa
nworld-geography-31-3.x: The Suez Route cuts through the Suez Canal and avoids the trip round Africa; the Cape of Good Hope route is the one round Africa.

n48ddecc8cc4.s: Which port led in liquid-bulk cargo in the port performance index?
n48ddecc8cc4.x: Sikka led liquid bulk; Paradip led dry bulk, while Mundra and JNPA led in container cargo.

ne8f93b7e8b6.s: ____ is not an export item of Andhra Pradesh.
ne8f93b7e8b6.x: Crude oil is not an AP export; marine products, pharmaceuticals, food products, textiles and engineering goods are.

n618bedf2816.s: For trade and tariff purposes, a Special Economic Zone is treated as:
o: Foreign territory only for income tax
Territory with no special customs treatment
n618bedf2816.x: An SEZ is treated as foreign territory for trade and tariffs and works through a single-window system.

n068187949cb.s: The SEZ Act, 2005 seeks to ____ domestic and foreign investment.
n068187949cb.x: Promotion of domestic and foreign investment is an objective of the SEZ Act, along with economic activity, exports, employment and infrastructure.

n296222c6abe.s: Unlike an SEZ, an Export Oriented Unit (EOU) is:
o: A single unit that may be located anywhere under the FTP scheme
A developer-led enclave with its own infrastructure
A demarcated enclave notified under the SEZ Act, 2005
A zone made up of a developer and several units
n296222c6abe.x: An EOU is a single unit located anywhere under the Foreign Trade Policy scheme; the developer-plus-units enclave belongs to an SEZ.

nfc76470bd52.s: Under CBIC guidelines, a new dry port is generally not allowed within how many km of a seaport?
nfc76470bd52.x: The CBIC norm bars a new dry port within 200 km of a seaport; 100 km applies to distance from an ICD.

nf9c79339455.s: Which of the following pairs about India's services sector is INCORRECTLY matched?
o: Share of India's GVA – More than half
nf9c79339455.x: India is the 7th largest services exporter, not 3rd; services give more than half of GVA and are the largest FDI recipient.

n3523c0ec682.s: Which country sends the most medical tourists to India?
n3523c0ec682.x: Bangladesh is the top source country for medical tourists to India, whose share in FTAs rose from 2.2% to about 6.5%.

n142a3cb5453.s: Which of the following is one of the seven anchor hubs of Andhra Pradesh tourism?
n142a3cb5453.x: The seven anchor hubs are Visakhapatnam, Tirupati, Araku, Rajahmundry, Amaravati, Srisailam and Gandikota; Kakinada is not one.

nabbb076c4a3.s: Which Indian UNESCO World Heritage Site is in the 'Mixed' category?
nabbb076c4a3.x: Khangchendzonga is India's mixed site; Kaziranga is natural, while Khajuraho and Mahabodhi are cultural.

n199cbf4247f.s: The new Polavaram district of Andhra Pradesh has its headquarters at:
n199cbf4247f.x: Polavaram district, formed on 31 December 2025, has its headquarters at Rampachodavaram; Markapuram is a separate new district.

new.s: India's current account deficit in FY 2025-26 was about what share of GDP?
new.x: The CAD was US$ 30.2 bn, about 1.1% of GDP, with services in surplus.

new.s: Which country was India's top crude oil supplier in 2025?
new.x: Russia was the top crude supplier in 2025; Saudi Arabia led earlier and Iraq in 2017-18.

new.s: Under the 1991 New Trade Policy, quantitative restrictions were replaced by a:
new.x: The 1991 reforms moved from quantitative restrictions to a price-based mechanism and eased licensing.

new.s: India's target of US$ 2 trillion exports by 2030 covers:
new.x: The US$ 2 trillion target is for goods plus services; US$ 1 trillion is the merchandise figure.

new.s: The US$ 100 bn target under the India-UAE CEPA relates to:
new.x: The UAE CEPA target is US$ 100 bn of trade; the US$ 100 bn commitment of the EFTA TEPA is investment.

new.s: India stayed out of the RCEP in:
new.x: RCEP joins ASEAN with China, Japan, Korea, Australia and New Zealand; India opted out in 2019.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT a member of Mercosur?
new.x: Mercosur members are Argentina, Brazil, Paraguay and Uruguay; Chile is not among them.

new.s: The Strait of Hormuz connects the Persian Gulf with the:
new.x: Hormuz links the Persian Gulf and the Gulf of Oman; the Gulf of Aden is linked to the Red Sea by Bab-el-Mandeb.

new.s: Which is Europe's largest seaport?
new.x: Rotterdam is Europe's largest port; Shanghai is the world's busiest container port.

new.s: Which is India's oldest and biggest artificial port?
new.x: Chennai (1881) is the oldest and biggest artificial port; Mumbai is the largest natural port.

new.s: The Sagarmala programme (2015) of the Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways is built on:
new.x: Sagarmala aims at port-led development through pillars such as port modernisation, connectivity and port-led industrialisation.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the Sagarmala programme:
1. It was launched in 2015.
2. Port-led industrialisation is one of its pillars.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Sagarmala began in 2015 under MoPSW; its five pillars include modernisation, connectivity and industrialisation.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT a reason for the east coast of India having fewer ports?
o: Deep water close to the shore
new.x: Deep water near the shore is a feature of the west coast; the east coast is deltaic, shallow, cyclone-prone and sediment-heavy.

new.s: Which was India's top merchandise import in FY 2024-25?
new.x: Crude petroleum is India's largest import, with 88-89% import dependence; gold and silver come next.

new.s: Which is the only major port of Andhra Pradesh?
new.x: Visakhapatnam is AP's only major port; Krishnapatnam, Kakinada and Gangavaram are non-major ports.

new.s: Visakhapatnam Port handled a record cargo of about how much in 2025-26?
new.x: Visakhapatnam handled a record 91.17 MMT in 2025-26, up from 82.62 MMT in 2024-25.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Visakhapatnam Port?
o: It is the only major port of AP
It is 2nd among east-coast major ports
It ranks 1st among all major ports
It handled a record 91.17 MMT in 2025-26
new.x: Visakhapatnam is 4th among major ports and 2nd on the east coast, not first overall.

new.s: In LEADS 2024, Andhra Pradesh was placed in which category?
new.x: AP was an Achiever in 2022 and 2023, a Fast Mover in 2024 and an Accelerator in LEADS 2025.

new.s: In LEADS 2025, Andhra Pradesh was ranked in which tier among coastal States?
new.x: LEADS 2025 has four tiers; AP was an Accelerator among coastal States.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about Andhra Pradesh's exports:
1. Crude oil is an export item of AP.
2. AP exports minerals and fish.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Crude oil is not an AP export (APPSC 2019); AP exports minerals and fish.

new.s: Andhra Pradesh's rank among States in coffee exports is:
new.x: AP is 2nd in coffee and 3rd in spices, while it is 1st in tobacco, marine products and ores.

new.s: Andhra Pradesh's rank among States in spices exports is:
new.x: AP is 3rd in spices exports; it is 2nd in coffee.

new.s: Andhra Pradesh exports 824 commodities to how many countries?
new.x: AP's export spread is 824 commodities to 194 countries.

new.s: The nodal agency for the Districts as Export Hubs initiative is:
new.x: DEH, launched in 2019 under the FTP, is run by the DGFT; ODOP was merged into it.

new.s: Coir, cashew and nursery plants are the DEH Phase-I products of which AP district?
new.x: East Godavari's products are coir, cashew and nursery plants; Guntur's are chillies, turmeric and cotton yarn.

new.s: The Pydibhimavaram pharma cluster is in which district?
new.x: Pydibhimavaram is in Srikakulam; Kakinada SEZ is in Kakinada district.

new.s: Which of the following SEZ/unit – district pairs is correctly matched?
new.x: APSEZ is at Atchutapuram-Rambilli in Anakapalli; Kakinada SEZ is in Kakinada, Sri City in Tirupati and Pydibhimavaram in Srikakulam.

new.s: Brandix Apparel City at Atchutapuram is associated with which sector?
new.x: Brandix at Atchutapuram is an apparel unit; Foxconn (electronics) and Isuzu (automobiles) are at Sri City.

new.s: Orvakal in Andhra Pradesh is a node of which industrial corridor?
new.x: Orvakal is a node of the HBIC, not of the VCIC/ECEC.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT a node of the Vizag-Chennai Industrial Corridor?
new.x: VCIC nodes are Visakhapatnam, Srikalahasti-Yerpedu and Kopparthy; Orvakal belongs to the HBIC.

new.s: The Dugarajapatnam shipbuilding cluster under AP's Maritime Policy aims at what share of national capacity by 2047?
new.x: The cluster built by NSHIP-AP Ltd targets 25% of national shipbuilding capacity by 2047.

new.s: AP's Industrial Development Policy 4.0 (2024-29) plans how many industrial parks?
new.x: IDP 4.0 plans 175+ industrial parks, with US$ 40 bn exports and 5 lakh jobs.

new.s: An SEZ proposal goes from the State to which body for approval?
new.x: SEZ proposals are sent by the State to the Board of Approval.

new.s: Which State received the most domestic tourist visits in 2024?
new.x: Uttar Pradesh led with about 646.8 mn domestic visits, followed by Tamil Nadu and Karnataka.

new.s: Which State received the most foreign tourist visits in 2024?
new.x: Maharashtra led foreign visits (~3.7 mn), followed by West Bengal.

new.s: Tourism provides about 8.46 crore jobs, i.e. what share of India's workforce?
new.x: Tourism jobs are 13.3% of the workforce; 5.22% is tourism's share of GDP (FY24).

new.s: Swadesh Darshan 2.0 differs from Swadesh Darshan 1.0 in being:
new.x: SD 2.0 is sustainable and destination-centric; SD 1.0 developed theme-based circuits, and PRASHAD covers only pilgrimage sites.

new.s: Which of the following tourism campaign/body – year pairs is correctly matched?
new.x: Incredible India was launched in 2002; ITDC dates from 1966, Adopt a Heritage from 2017 and Swadesh Darshan 1.0 from 2015.

new.s: The India Tourism Development Corporation (ITDC) was set up in:
new.x: ITDC was set up in 1966; Incredible India came in 2002.

new.s: Sarnath, inscribed in 2026, became India's which UNESCO World Heritage Site?
new.x: Sarnath is the 45th; the Maratha Military Landscapes (2025) were the 44th.

new.s: How many of India's 45 UNESCO World Heritage Sites are natural sites?
new.x: India has 37 cultural, 7 natural and 1 mixed site.

new.s: Kalinjar Hill, declared a geo-heritage site in 2026, is in:
new.x: Kalinjar Hill is in Banda (UP), not Nandyal.

new.s: Haflong is the only hill station of:
new.x: Haflong is Assam's only hill station.

new.s: Which is the only hill station in the Aravallis?
new.x: Mount Abu in Rajasthan is the only hill station in the Aravallis; Auli and Chakrata are in Uttarakhand, Munnar in Kerala.

new.s: Which of the following beach/hill station – State pairs is correctly matched?
new.x: Gopnath is in Bhavnagar, Gujarat; Digha is in West Bengal, Munnar in Kerala and Auli in Uttarakhand.

new.s: Which city is called the yoga capital of India?
new.x: Rishikesh in Uttarakhand is the yoga capital.

new.s: Sarnath and Kushinagar are in which State?
new.x: Sarnath and Kushinagar are in UP; Bodh Gaya is in Bihar.

new.s: Suryalanka beach is near which town?
new.x: Suryalanka is near Bapatla, with a Rs 97.52 crore Swadesh Darshan 2.0 project.

new.s: Manginapudi beach is near which town?
new.x: Manginapudi is near Machilipatnam; Vodarevu is near Chirala and Perupalem near Narasapuram.

new.s: The Kanaka Durga temple at Vijayawada stands on which hill?
new.x: Kanaka Durga is on Indrakeeladri; Tirumala is on Seshachalam and Annavaram on Ratnagiri.

new.s: The Yaganti temple, known for its growing Nandi, is in which district?
new.x: Yaganti Uma Maheswara temple is in the Erramala hills of Nandyal district.

new.s: Belum Caves were found in 1884 by:
new.x: Robert Bruce Foote found Belum Caves (1884); William King George found Borra Caves (1807).

new.s: Thimmamma Marrimanu, the banyan with the largest canopy, is in which district?
new.x: Thimmamma Marrimanu is in Sri Sathya Sai district.

new.s: Maredumilli is in which district of Andhra Pradesh?
new.x: Maredumilli is in Polavaram district, not Nandyal.

new.s: The Buddhist site of Salihundam is in which district?
new.x: Salihundam is in Srikakulam; Sankaram is in Anakapalli, Guntupalli in Eluru, Bavikonda in Visakhapatnam.

new.s: The Undavalli rock-cut caves, with a reclining Vishnu, are in which district?
new.x: Undavalli caves are in Guntur; Kondapalli Fort is in NTR district.

new.s: Etikoppaka lacquer toys, made with natural dyes, belong to which district?
new.x: Etikoppaka toys are from Anakapalli; Kondapalli toys are from NTR district.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about tourism employment in Andhra Pradesh:
1. Hotels, transport and guides provide direct jobs.
2. Supply-chain jobs are indirect jobs.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Direct jobs are in hotels, transport and guiding; supply-chain jobs are indirect.

new.s: AP's IT and GCC Policy 4.0 (2024-29) plans co-working and neighbourhood workspaces in:
new.x: The policy plans co-working and neighbourhood workspaces in Tirupati, Visakhapatnam and Vijayawada.

new.s: Ganga Vilas (2023), the world's longest river cruise, runs between:
new.x: Ganga Vilas sails from Varanasi to Dibrugarh.

new.s: The Ancient Monuments and Archaeological Sites and Remains (AMASR) Act was passed in:
new.x: The AMASR Act is of 1958; the Antiquities and Art Treasures Act is of 1972.
